topic: Forecasting and recalculation scope for multiple companies
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the scope of data processing, specifically regarding forecasting and recalculation for multiple companies. It was confirmed that the current aggregates include data for all six specified companies. A key decision point was whether to enable the forecast calculation for all companies. If this is decided, [me] will remove the limitation restricting the aggregate data only to those six companies.

Additionally, questions were raised about running a night recalculation for these companies and adjusting the filtering condition (specifically removing `NOT is_fake`) while calculating from December 2023.
decisions: The scope of aggregates includes all six specified companies.
If implementing forecasting for all companies, the restriction on aggregate data will be removed.
action_items: Determine if forecasting should be enabled for all companies.
Confirm running a night recalculation and adjusting filters (removing `NOT is_fake`) starting from December 2023.
